instructions: Deploy first as the primary libinjection-based XSS detection rule. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni transformations (only one pass needed after utf8toUnicode). Requires libinjection support in ModSecurity build.
Focused script tag detection. Replaces original rule 910004 and the script branch of 910001. The [^>]{0,512} bound prevents ReDoS. Apply after rule 910000.

Covers event-handler XSS across common HTML tags. Consolidates original rules 910002 and 910005 (img onerror is a subset). Removed optional opening angle bracket to reduce false positives on non-tag contexts; the tag name anchor is sufficient.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|ARGS_NAMES|REQUEST_HEADERS|REQUEST_COOKIES|XML:/* "@rx (?i:(?:\b(?:src|href|data|action|xlink:href)\s*=\s*)?javascript\s*:)" "id:910003,phase:2,deny,status:403,t:none,t:utf8toUnicode,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:jsDecode,t:cssDecode,t:removeNulls,t:lowercase,log,auditlog,capture,msg:'JavaScript URI scheme detected in request input',logdata:'%{TX.0}',tag:'attack-xss',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Detects javascript: URI scheme with optional attribute context. Added xlink:href to attribute list. Deploy after normalization-heavy rules.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|ARGS_NAMES|REQUEST_HEADERS|REQUEST_COOKIES|XML:/* "@rx (?i:(?:%25){2,}[0-9a-f]{2}|(?:%[0-9a-f]{2}){8,}|(?:&#(?:x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+);){3,})" "id:910004,phase:2,deny,status:403,t:none,t:utf8toUnicode,t:removeNulls,t:lowercase,log,auditlog,capture,msg:'Excessive multi-layer encoding or entity obfuscation pattern',logdata:'%{TX.0}',tag:'attack-evasion',tag:'attack-xss',severity:'ERROR'"
instructions: Detects multi-layer percent encoding and HTML entity chains used to evade WAF normalization. Fixed the %25 pattern to require at least one encoded byte after the double-percent prefix. Applied to raw input (no urlDecodeUni) so the pattern fires before decoding strips the evidence.

Upgraded original rule 910006 from pass/log to deny. Added eval, setTimeout, setInterval as high-risk JS sinks. These functions in request input represent concrete XSS execution attempts and should be blocked, not just logged.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|ARGS_NAMES|REQUEST_HEADERS|REQUEST_COOKIES|XML:/* "@rx (?i:(?:<|<)[^\r\n]{0,64}(?:svg|img|iframe|script|marker|sup|body)[^\r\n]{0,256}(?:on(?:load|error|mouseover|focus|animationstart)|javascript:|alert\s*\(|confirm\s*\())" "id:910006,phase:2,deny,status:403,t:none,t:utf8toUnicode,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:jsDecode,t:cssDecode,t:removeNulls,t:lowercase,log,auditlog,capture,msg:'Correlated XSS chain: HTML tag combined with executable sink',logdata:'%{TX.0}',tag:'attack-xss',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Consolidated correlated XSS chain rule (formerly 910009). Tightened the pre-tag wildcard to [^\r\n]{0,64} to prevent catastrophic backtracking. Broadened event handler list. This catches multi-component payloads that might slip individual component rules.
